objective: Use one observable output defect to trace backward through Writer realization into the mapped Plan node, classify the bounded fault region, and produce one smallest-scope intervention without expanding the runtime into a generic platform.

decisions.decision: Instrument only Plan and Write for the first white-box slice.
decisions.reason: The first useful uncertainty split is whether a prose defect was already encoded in planning or introduced during realization.

decisions.decision: Use archived Round-01 B03 as the first trace fixture rather than fabricate a new live run.
decisions.reason: Round-01 already contains writing-plan.json, writer-report.json, exact beat mappings and zero reported deviations.

decisions.decision: Seed the trace with EXPO​SITION_LOAD.EXPLANATION_BEFORE_NEED anchored to an exact candidate sentence.
decisions.reason: The symptom is observable in the prose and the mapped Plan beat contains an inspectable pre-resolved interpretation, making Plan-vs-realization attribution falsifiable.

decisions.decision: Derive PLAN_FAILURE only when Writer mapping is REALIZED with no beat deviation and the same symptom is explicitly observed in the mapped Plan node.
decisions.reason: This keeps observations separate from diagnosis and avoids relying on Writer self-assertion alone.

decisions.decision: Create a PLAN_ONLY intervention for B03 rather than rewrite the whole harness.
decisions.reason: The MVP learning rule is smallest targeted change to the diagnosed region.

decisions.decision: Do not claim a successful learning iteration until a live Writer rerun exists and Product/owner measurement evaluates it.
decisions.reason: This session has no live model-execution adapter inside the repository runtime; fabricating a rerun would invalidate the learning loop.

validation.scope_note: The same three production-baseline failures were already present during Phase 2 validation. All newly added Phase 3 tests passed before the unrelated baseline failures terminated the repository-wide unit-test step.

trace_result.output_span: Khối cầu niêm phong bảo đảm an toàn cho số lượng, song cái giá phải trả là sự mù mịt về thị giác.

intervention.prediction: Reduce or remove EXPLANATION_BEFORE_NEED while preserving truth qualification, artifact clarity and sequence continuity.

output.next_required_step: Execute one live Writer realization with the same evidence ceiling and Writer contract while changing only the B03 plan representation, then return the new prose to the Phase 1 Product/owner measurement surface.
